overview.description: The American Beacon Aberdeen Municipal High Income ETF (AMHI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is actively managed, seeking a high level of current income through exposure to USD-denominated tax-exempt municipal bonds. Security selection combines proprietary credit research, top-down macroeconomic analysis, and bottom-up fundamental research. AMHI was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by American Beacon.

data.text: IRVING, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Announcing launch of American Beacon Aberdeen Municipal High Income ETF (AMHI), active ETF built on a high-conviction municipal bond strategy.
